policy: Levels are cumulative. Promotion requires evidence-backed answers and cannot be earned by severity guessing or memorizing fixture labels.

levels.name: Code Review
skills: trace source to validation to sink

levels.name: Architecture
skills: reason about framework and infrastructure controls

levels.name: Black-box Verification
skills: design bounded local or staging verification
record reproducible evidence without destructive testing

levels.name: Business Logic
skills: reason about ownership price quota and state transitions

levels.name: Attack Chains
skills: assign chain impact from proven outcome rather than severity inflation

levels.name: Unknown Research
skills: form falsifiable hypotheses for unfamiliar systems
design a safe verifier before making a vulnerability claim
